title: Filipino Cranberry Pudding
description: A simple dessert recipe that combines the sweetness of cranberries with the richness of Filipino-style pudding. Serve chilled and enjoy!
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine cranberries, pudding mix, milk, sugar, and salt. Whisk until well combined.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the pudding has thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in melted butter and vanilla extract (if using).
Let cool to room temperature, then refrigerate until chilled.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional cranberries if desired.
